evidence_scope.requests: Persisted SSE data records and client receipt clocks; no TCP packet/chunk capture.
evidence_scope.socket: Raw integer and normalized boolean checked against requested arm; first accepted socket receipt. Later readbacks enforced by pinned fatal handler, not individually persisted.
evidence_scope.restore: Persisted identity_match plus prior identity and T-to-running state; post-restore raw identity string was not persisted.
evidence_scope.resources: Sampled raw command values; process inventory native rows are persisted parser results, not full ps output. No GPU peak inference.
evidence_scope.pins: Small new/frozen core/tokenizer files independently hashed. Large weights/runtime inherited full hashes are runner before/after receipts; not reread.
